title: NetworkUserReportListResult
description: network.user-report-list-result@1 (ask 287): GET /api/v1/staff/user-reports on OpenVibe.Network, the staff queue for people holding staff.moderation.logs. Newest first, filtered by status (default open) and target subject, at most 200 rows (`limit`, default 50). A caller without the capability gets 403 user_reports.forbidden (problem+json).
